DTCs.name: Fuel Pump Circuit Malfunction
DTCs.description: Fuel pump is not receiving proper voltage or is not operating correctly.

DTCs.name: Fuel Pressure Too Low
DTCs.description: Detected fuel rail pressure below specified range.

DTCs.name: Fuel Pressure Too High
DTCs.description: Detected fuel rail pressure above specified range.

DTCs.name: Fuel Injector Circuit Malfunction
DTCs.description: One or more fuel injectors not receiving proper signal or voltage.

DTCs.name: Fuel Temperature Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Fuel temperature reading missing or out of range.

DTCs.name: Fuel Level Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Fuel level sensor signal not detected or inconsistent.

DTCs.name: Fuel Tank Pressure Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Fuel tank pressure sensor signal out of range or missing.

DTCs.name: EVAP Canister Purge Valve Fault
DTCs.description: Purge valve not operating correctly or signal missing.

DTCs.name: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Fuel rail pressure sensor signal missing or out of range.

DTCs.name: Fuel Pump Control Module Fault
DTCs.description: Fuel pump control module not operating correctly.
